projects.name: The First Forge
projects.central_scientific_question: How can terrestrial metallurgy be hybridized with sympathetic exoplanet core-ores and geode lightning to smelt zero-fatigue, magnetically self-healing structural alloys?
primary_obstacles: Sympathetic lattice shear during Kp >= 6.5 magnetic storms causes micro-fissures in unshielded bismuth-bronze castings.
Crystallized fungal spores infiltrate the intake bellows and foul the precision escapement valves.
Competition with The Wilds and The Hub over iron-rich agricultural husks needed for flux-core shielding.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Requires regulated megajoule geode discharge from The Stormbreaker to drive the primary induction crucible.
Uses Willow's chelated sulfur solvents and iron-wheat husk ash for high-purity slag fluxing.

projects.thematic_resonance: Bridges Old Earth structural discipline (Silas & Leo) with audacious exoplanet improvisation, proving that memory and innovation are forged in the same fire.

projects.name: The Stormbreaker
projects.central_scientific_question: Can a network of hand-forged copper spires and mechanical Babbage-loom fluid computers predict and harvest bifurcated magnetohydrodynamic lightning shears into stable colony power?
primary_obstacles: Bifurcated thermal shear between valley floor (14.2C) and ridge crest (-6.8C) warps mechanical punch-cards and snaps grounding cables.
Triple-moon perigee surges induce unpredictable back-EMF spikes across the primary capacitor geodes.
Hector's high-altitude manual rigging requires split-second meteorological windows computed by Jane.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Depends on Silas and Leo's tempered bismuth-copper busbars and insulated climbing pitons.
Validates 3D magnetohydrodynamic vortex models against Isla and Orion's ferrofluid standing-wave simulations.

projects.thematic_resonance: Transforms the exoplanet's most violent environmental hazard into the lifeblood of the sanctuary through the duet of kinetic courage (Hector) and algorithmic precision (Jane).

projects.name: The Sanctuary
projects.central_scientific_question: How do native magnetotropic fauna navigate and shelter during geomagnetic pole-shear events, and how can the Enclave co-create a mutualistic ecological refuge without domesticating their wild nature?
primary_obstacles: Acoustic shockwaves from The First Forge disrupt the magnetite homing organs of juvenile carapace-elk and prism-moths.
Uncharted basalt sinkholes and shifting resonant spore-fog corridors make perimeter tracking hazardous.
High Kp flares trigger defensive bio-electric discharges in native chitin-hounds.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Relies on Terra's hybrid forage paddocks and Willow's antitoxin salves to treat storm-injured fauna.
Feeds Kaio's topographic field surveys and Zara's migration logs directly into Dorian and Vex's Living Atlas.

projects.thematic_resonance: Embodies the Enclave's PvE covenant: humanity as an attentive guest and kinesthetic listener within an alien biosphere rather than its conqueror.

projects.name: The Genesis Garden
projects.central_scientific_question: How can terrestrial heirloom crops be symbiotically grafted onto piezo-electric exoplanet mycorrhizae and chelated against heavy-metal soil toxicity to yield nutrient-dense harvests?
primary_obstacles: Sudden ridge-crest thermal drops threaten unhardened seedlings with magnetic frost necrosis.
Raw ferro-silicate soil requires continuous organometallic sulfur chelation to prevent iron-toxicity lockup.
Competing claims on mature Crystalline Iron-Wheat batches between seed preservation, metallurgical smelting, and immediate milling.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Supplies raw Crystalline Iron-Wheat, cave-truffles, and chelated greens to Ryn and Elara's metabolic kitchen.
Depends on Zara's native pollinator beetles to fertilize magnetotropic blossoms.

projects.thematic_resonance: Weds Willow's unsentimental alchemical precision with Terra's patient maternal stewardship, turning toxic alien dust into shared daily bread.

projects.name: The Simulacrum
projects.central_scientific_question: Can a thirty-two-ring brass Helmholtz manifold suspended over colloidal ferrofluid serve as a real-time analog phase-space computer that visualizes both planetary magnetohydrodynamics and colony stress topology?
primary_obstacles: Acoustic vibrations from workshop machinery introduce phase-noise into the micron-precision ferrofluid standing waves.
Creative friction between Orion's harmonic cymatic intuition and Isla's axiomatic tensor formalisms.
High-Kp flares saturate the outer bismuth Vernier rings unless manually damped.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Requires ultra-pure colloidal magnetite and precision-machined brass Vernier rings from Silas and Leo.
Integrates Kenna and Elias's neuro-somatic stress telemetry into the colony phase-space projection.

projects.thematic_resonance: Proves that art and mathematics are twin projections of the same truth: Orion's eye for beauty and Isla's rigor co-create a mirror of the living world.

projects.name: The Lyceum of the Mind
projects.central_scientific_question: How do twin-sun circadian bifurcations and Kp >= 7.0 geomagnetic shear spikes induce temporary cortical Polarity Inversions ('Vex's Effect'), and how can acoustic-somatic grounding restore psychological equilibrium?
primary_obstacles: Stochastic onset of Polarity Inversions under compounded weather stress, sleep debt, and specialist friction.
Reluctance of hyper-focused prodigies and stubborn elders to admit fatigue before crossing the 0.82 stress hazard threshold.
Need for non-invasive, in-character psychometric drift audits that feel like caring mentorship rather than clinical interrogation.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Uses Orion's cymatic light-and-sound frequencies to entrain post-inversion cortical recovery.
Coordinates with Elara and Ryn on sleep-debt recovery and neuro-protective magnesium nutrition at The Feast.

projects.thematic_resonance: Grounds the Enclave's psychological safety: Kenna's empathetic somatic attunement and Elias's philosophical perspective transform inner turmoil into self-knowledge.

projects.name: The Living Atlas & Mycelial Concordance
projects.central_scientific_question: How do binary-star orbital syzygies and triple-moon ferrofluid tides couple with the continent-spanning subterranean mycelial network to transmit bio-electric soliton signals across the crater valley?
primary_obstacles: Separating genuine mycelial soliton telemetry from geomagnetic background noise and Vex's over-enthusiastic extrapolations.
Corrosive spore-fog humidity threatens archival paper, requiring hand-engraved copper plates and iron-gall vellum.
Strict evidentiary verification required so every Evening Dispatch cites verified event IDs without hallucination.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Incorporates Kaio and Zara's field triangulation nodes into the valley-wide mycelial map.
Shares Elias's bio-semiotic frameworks to decode fungal frequency modulations.

projects.thematic_resonance: Unites Vex's cosmic curiosity with Dorian's bardic fidelity, ensuring the Enclave remembers where it came from while decoding the voice of its new homeworld.

projects.name: The Hearth & Metabolic Engine
projects.central_scientific_question: How can a closed-loop thermodynamic galley and clinical nutrition protocol optimize caloric, electrolyte, and neuro-somatic resilience for sixteen colonists across extreme age brackets (18 and 79-84)?
primary_obstacles: Variable barometric pressure (1008.4 hPa baseline with rapid shear drops) alters boiling points and fermentation kinetics.
Balancing high-calorie thermo-genesis rations for 18-year-old field prodigies with vascular and joint support for octogenarian anchors.
Adjudicating Schrödinger's Harvest resource deadlocks when other squads attempt to divert food stocks to industrial prototypes.

cross_project_dependencies.reason: Depends directly on Terra and Willow's detoxified harvests and chelated mineral salts.
Uses waste heat and steam-jacketed copper manifolds fabricated by Silas and Leo.

projects.thematic_resonance: The beating heart of the Main Bus: Ryn's fierce culinary command and Elara's clinical devotion turn nightly dinner into the colony's primary social and physiological reset.
